occupancy.label: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Patient days / available bed-days. Values outside 0–100% are unavailable.
occupancy.aggregation: Unweighted median of valid facility ratios; never ratio of cohort totals.
occupancy.missingPolicy: Null on missing/nonfinite inputs or nonpositive denominator; zero is retained.
occupancy.eligibility: 300–430 inclusive report days for benchmarking and history.
occupancy.scope: CMS hospital cost-report complex; not necessarily a single physical campus.

policies.reportSelection: Prefer a 300–430-day report, then longest duration, latest end date, highest report ID. One report per CCN/source year; not a calendar-year aggregation.
policies.time: Dataset year is a grouping, not a calendar-year standardization. Many reports end the following year.
policies.changes: Adjacent datasets; eligible, nonoverlapping target periods with gap <=60 days. Percent differences are percentage points.
policies.money: Nominal USD. Flow annualization uses 365.25 / report days.
policies.ranking: Eligible matching hospitals; target is included in a market ranking but excluded from its own peer benchmark.
policies.balanced: Metric-specific fixed CCNs with valid values in every selected dataset.
policies.scope: Descriptive; no case-mix, wage, teaching or clinical-quality adjustment.
policies.workforce: Exact report-ID/CCN/fiscal-period match. Nonnegative reported values only; zero retained, missing never imputed. Payroll FTEs are period averages, never annualized.
policies.workforceEndpointReview: Payroll FTE and workload endpoint-change rankings exclude missing/nonpositive FTE endpoints and more than fourfold changes in FTEs, annualized patient days or patient days per FTE. Guided raw trends retain values with target warnings. Review flags are not proof of errors.
